title: Solubility
description: How much of a salt water will hold is a solubility product, K_sp. Concentrate a brine and its salts come out in order. Unlocks the Brine Evaporator.

puzzle.goal: A salt that splits into two ions has solubility product K. Write how many grams g dissolve in V litres, if one mole of it weighs m grams.
puzzle.name: Saturation
puzzle.ask: Find g for gypsum: K = @{K}, m = @{m} g/mol, V = @{V} L.
puzzle.method: Each ion is at s mol/L, so K = s²: s = √K moles a litre.
